vuln.name: CSP Allows Unsafe Inline Style
vuln.description: The Content-Security-Policy style-src directive permits 'unsafe-inline', allowing inline style attributes and <style> elements. This weakens CSP and can enable some CSS-based data exfiltration.
vuln.impact: Lower than unsafe-inline script, but still weakens CSP and can enable CSS-based data exfiltration attacks.
vuln.recommendation: Remove 'unsafe-inline' from style-src where feasible; use nonces or hashes for inline styles.
